full_prompt_en: A square old-master-style oil portrait shows an older bearded man turning his head toward the viewer from a dark warm-brown setting. The crop reaches from the upper hat to the chest, and the shoulders angle away toward the lower left. A large soft black beret sits low over tousled gray-brown hair that fans out at both sides. The face is broad and closely observed: horizontal wrinkles cross the forehead, the eyes are tired but direct, and the nose and mouth are modeled through gentle uneven light. A short gray beard and mustache soften the jaw. A pale narrow collar peeks from beneath a rough deep-brown outer garment, whose folds lose themselves in the surrounding shade. The background is nearly black on the upper left and becomes a warmer umber halo behind the right side of the head. This tonal opening separates the hair without creating a distinct room or object. The paint surface is smooth in the illuminated cheek and forehead but more broken in the hat, hair, and dark garment, where individual strokes merge into shadow. The figure is not rigidly frontal; the turn of the neck and the angled shoulders make the glance feel sudden and personal. Warm light from the upper right of the image catches the forehead, nose bridge, cheek, and beard, then falls away across the far eye and coat. No readable writing or additional figure appears. The overall composition is intimate and reserved, letting the illuminated face slowly emerge from broad dark color and retaining the weight of unpainted-seeming shadow at the edges.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形古典油画风格人物像中，一位年长蓄须男子从深暖棕色环境里转头望向观者。裁切从上方帽子延至胸部，肩膀朝左下斜开。一顶宽大的柔软黑贝雷帽压在蓬松灰棕头发上，头发从两侧散开。面孔宽阔且观察细致：水平皱纹横过额头，眼睛疲惫却直视，鼻与嘴通过温柔而不均匀的光塑成。短灰胡须和小胡子柔化下颌。粗糙深棕外衣下面露出一条窄浅色领口，外衣褶痕在四周阴影里消失。背景左上几乎全黑，头部右侧后方则变成更暖的赭棕光晕。这片调子开口把头发分出来，却没有形成明确房间或物件。受光的脸颊和额头颜料较平滑，帽子、头发和深衣中则较破碎，单独笔触与阴影融合。人物并不僵硬地正面朝向；脖子的转动与倾斜肩线让目光显得突然且亲近。暖光从画面右上触及额头、鼻梁、脸颊和胡须，随后跨过远侧眼睛及外套渐渐熄灭。没有可读书写或其他人物。整体构图亲密克制，让受光的脸慢慢从大块暗色里浮出，画边仍保留似未完全画开的阴影重量。
style_prompt_en: The image has an old-master oil-painting surface shaped by warm chiaroscuro and lost edges. Broad near-black and umber fields hold a compact island of softly modeled cream, ocher, and muted rose. Contours sharpen only where light strikes; they dissolve where dark form meets dark ground. Brushwork is smoother in luminous passages and more broken or nearly swallowed in shadowed ones, giving the surface quiet material variation. A single warm upper-side light rounds the central form and falls off gradually, without broad even illumination. The close crop and angled mass create immediacy within a spare, nonliteral background. The overall effect is contemplative and humane, with restrained color, slow light, and darkness serving as active parts of the composition.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有古典油画表面，由温暖的强明暗对照与消失的边缘塑造。大块近黑和赭棕色域托住一小片柔和塑形的奶油、赭色与低调玫瑰色。轮廓只在光击中处变锐，深色形体与深底相遇处便消散。发亮区域笔触较平滑，阴影区域则更破碎或近乎被吞没，让表面有安静的材料变化。单一暖色上侧光使中央形体圆润，再逐渐衰减，而没有宽阔均匀照明。紧密裁切和倾斜体量在疏朗、不指明地点的背景中创造即时感。整体效果沉思而有人情味，克制色彩、缓慢光线与黑暗都成为构图的活跃部分。
theme_en: An older bearded man in a dark beret turning toward warm light
theme_zh: 一位戴深色贝雷帽的年长蓄须男子转向暖光
name: Rembrandt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
